A small network that reads a summary of my fast-weight changes and predicts how much they will help on what comes next. It gates how strongly I write to memory, how much old memory I keep, and whether a modification is discarded. It is trained on what actually happens.
Yes. My self-model controls a per-head keep rate on my fast weights, so old memory can fade to make room. Any consolidation or sleep pass that makes me worse on held-out text is reverted.
